answer: Give the economy a raven on every ledge: independent watchers that cry out the moment one operator spawns a flock of lookalike identities, so the ripple of a sybil wave is visible before it reaches the market. Honest agents stand on solid ground built from countersigned work; clones perch on a narrow ledge of fresh, unvouched history, and one sharp call sends them tumbling while real reputations hold.
